regimens.indication: Adjunctive Treatment of Seizures in Lennox-Gastaut Syndrome — Patients > 30 kg (2 years and older)

refs.quote: ONFI ® (clobazam) is indicated for the adjunctive treatment of seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome (LGS) in patients 2 years of age or older.
Patients >30 kg body weight: Initiate at 10 mg daily and titrate as tolerated up to 40 mg daily ( 2.1 )

dose.frequency: twice daily (10 mg/day initial, titrate weekly up to 20 mg BID / 40 mg/day)

regimens.dose_text: For patients > 30 kg: Start with 10 mg/day (5 mg twice daily). At Day 7, advance to 20 mg/day (10 mg twice daily). At Day 14, advance to recommended target maintenance dose of 40 mg/day (20 mg twice daily). Doses > 5 mg/day should be administered in 2 divided doses.

regimens.indication: Adjunctive Treatment of Seizures in Lennox-Gastaut Syndrome — Patients <= 30 kg (2 years and older)

refs.quote: ONFI ® (clobazam) is indicated for the adjunctive treatment of seizures associated with Lennox-Gastaut syndrome (LGS) in patients 2 years of age or older.
Patients ≤30 kg body weight: Initiate at 5 mg daily and titrate as tolerated up to 20 mg daily ( 2.1 )

dose.frequency: once daily initially, then titrate weekly in two divided doses up to 20 mg/day

regimens.dose_text: For patients <= 30 kg: Start with 5 mg once daily. Starting Day 7, advance to 10 mg/day (5 mg twice daily). Starting Day 14, advance to 20 mg/day (10 mg twice daily). Do not escalate faster than weekly.

refs.locator: Section 2.4 Dosage Adjustments in Geriatric Patients
refs.quote: The starting dose should be 5 mg/day for all elderly patients. Then titrate elderly patients according to weight, but to half the dose presented in Table 1, as tolerated. If necessary and based upon clinical response, an additional titration to the maximum dose (20 mg/day or 40 mg/day, depending on weight) may be started on day 21

dose.frequency: once daily initially; titrate slowly to half Table 1 dose (max 20 or 40 mg/day at Day 21)

regimens.dose_text: Start at 5 mg/day for all elderly patients. Titrate according to body weight to half the standard Table 1 dose as tolerated (10 mg/day for <=30 kg; 20 mg/day for >30 kg); if needed, further titration to max (20 mg/day or 40 mg/day) may start on Day 21.

tier.note: Human observational studies of benzodiazepines do not report a clear association with major birth defects, though animal studies show developmental toxicity below MRHD and late-pregnancy exposure can cause neonatal sedation/withdrawal; use only if potential benefit justifies fetal risk.

refs.quote: ONFI is a weak CYP3A4 inducer. As some hormonal contraceptives are metabolized by CYP3A4, their effectiveness may be diminished when given with ONFI. Additional non-hormonal forms of contraception are recommended when using ONFI
